description:
Who can be nominated

This internal award is restricted to US citizens enrolled in Northwestern PhD programmes, normally in their second, third or fourth year. It is not an open international admission scholarship.

About the Fellowship

Northwestern's Nicholson Fellowship supports outstanding current PhD students in science, engineering and management. It is an internal graduate award providing nine months of stipend support and tuition payment, with a separate reference deadline.

Research Areas

  • Sciences
  • Engineering
  • Management research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionInternal doctoral fellowship
Stipend / salaryFull tuition and nine months of stipend at the University Fellowship rate; one-year internal award.
DurationNine months

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityCurrent Northwestern PhD students
Further conditionsExisting Northwestern PhD students in sciences, engineering and management.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen: internal nomination
Deadline / consideration round11 January 2027, 23:59 Central Time; references 15 January
LocationUnited States

How to Apply

  1. Confirm your eligibility as a current doctoral student and review the internal award requirements.
  2. Follow the university’s nomination process and arrange the supporting materials requested by your programme.
  3. Complete the internal submission by the nomination deadline and arrange reference submissions where required.

About Northwestern University

Northwestern offers doctoral programmes through its graduate schools. The Nicholson Fellowship is an internal award for selected PhD students and uses the university's nomination and application process.
